title: Blender and EMtools
description: The unit proxies, the survey and the cameras with their photos into an Extended Matrix project, named after the nodes of the em.json of PyArchInit or EMStudio; Blender kept up to date as the proxies change; the proxies modelled in Blender back with their volume; the selection shared live with EMtools 1.6, which starts the proxies of units without one
